name: io.github.proofable/mcp
title: Proofable MCP
description: One profile every AI tool you use already knows, with only what is true now.

tools.name: proofable_context
tools.description: Returns the signed-in profile: proof index (contextIndex), agents with their agentId and wallet, their permissions, credit balance and the available checks. Call it once, first; its IDs feed proofable_proofs_get, proofable_agent_mount and proofable_job_create. Read-only and free. Signed out, it returns the public check summary and how to sign in.

tools.name: proofable_verify_or_guide
tools.description: Returns the existing proofs that satisfy the listed checks, or the next step: call proofable_verify when you are signed in as that wallet and every check is ownership-basic; otherwise a hosted verify link to share. Use it first for any request to prove something about an account; to run a check now, use proofable_verify; for a pass or fail gate answer, use proofable_proofs_check. Stores nothing and spends nothing. Works signed out when walletAddress is passed.

tools.name: proofable_verifiers_catalog
tools.description: Lists every check Proofable can run, with its ID, required inputs and supported networks. Call it before proofable_verify_or_guide, proofable_proofs_check, proofable_verify or proofable_verify_prepare to get a valid check ID and exact input names. Read-only, free, and available signed out.

tools.name: proofable_proofs_check
tools.description: Returns eligible (true or false) and matchedCount: does a wallet already hold the proofs a gate requires? Use it to gate access or eligibility; it never returns proof content. To get the proofs or the next step to earn one, use proofable_verify_or_guide; to read records, use proofable_proofs_get. Read-only and free. Signed out, pass the wallet; signed in, omit it.

tools.name: proofable_verify
tools.description: Runs one or more checks on the signed-in account and saves one proof for the call, returning its qHash; status is verified, or partially_verified when only some checks pass. Charged per requested check only when the proof is saved; a failed run costs nothing. Call proofable_verify_or_guide first to reuse a proof. When a different wallet must sign, use proofable_verify_prepare and proofable_verify_submit. To grant or change an existing agent permission, pass agent-delegation; confirm with proofable_agent_link. To create an agent, use proofable_agent_create.

tools.name: proofable_verify_prepare
tools.description: Step 1 of 2 when a wallet other than the signed-in account must sign. Returns the exact message (signerString), timestamp and chain, plus a hosted link as a fallback. EVM wallets sign with personal_sign; Solana wallets sign the message bytes with Ed25519. Creates no proof and spends nothing. Send the signature, the same inputs and the returned timestamp to proofable_verify_submit before the timestamp expires. When the signed-in account is the subject, use proofable_verify.

tools.name: proofable_verify_submit
tools.description: Step 2 of 2: submits the signature from proofable_verify_prepare and saves one proof for the call, returning its qHash. Pass the same wallet, checks, data and chain, plus the returned timestamp, before it expires. Charged per requested check only when the proof is saved; a failed run costs nothing.

tools.name: proofable_proofs_get
tools.description: Reads proofs: one proof by qHash, or a page of proofs filtered by text, tag, check or scope. Returns metadata; set include=content for bodies and includeComments=true with a qHash for comments. Signed in, omit identifier to read your own. Read-only and free. For a pass or fail answer, use proofable_proofs_check; for the next step to a proof you lack, use proofable_verify_or_guide.

tools.name: proofable_proofs_update
tools.description: Makes one change per call: an owner edit (title, tags and visibility together), a vote, or a comment. Owner edits need ownership; votes and comments need read access, and comments cannot be edited or deleted here. Making a shared proof private removes outside access, so confirm with the user first. In a job run, the agent needs manage_proofs. An owner edit writes metadata, then visibility; if visibility fails, the metadata change stays. To withdraw a proof everywhere, use proofable_proof_revoke.

tools.name: proofable_proof_revoke
tools.description: Revokes a proof you own, effective immediately: the record is deleted, so every app that checks it finds no proof. Revoking an agent-delegation proof ends that agent permission; its qHash is proofs.delegation.qHash from proofable_agent_link. Cannot be undone; to hide a proof and keep it valid, change its visibility with proofable_proofs_update.

tools.name: proofable_agent_link
tools.description: Reports whether an agent may act for your profile and what it may do now: linked:true with the identity proof and active permission, or link_required with the one next step. It does not create, change, or remove anything. Use it before proofable_job_create when unsure. To grant or change permission, use proofable_verify with agent-delegation; to act as the agent, use proofable_agent_mount.

tools.name: proofable_agent_create
tools.description: Creates an agent you control with a preset permission (default assistant). By default it runs on your own wallet, scoped by agentId. For its own wallet, pass the public address, have that key sign the returned signerString, submit it with the returned nextCall before it expires, then call again with the identityQHash. Spends credits per new proof. A repeat call keeps the permission unless you pass preset or actions, and rebuilds the profile from the values you pass.

tools.name: proofable_agent_mount
tools.description: Returns an agent identity, permissions, instructions and skills for your client to follow; Proofable enforces the permission inside job runs. Returns identity, delegation, tools, resources and an enforce block (allowedActions, deniedActions, requiresHumanApproval). Read-only and free. Pass agentId, or agentWallet when the ID is unknown. To check permission only, use proofable_agent_link; to run work as the agent, use proofable_job_create; to add an agent, use proofable_agent_create.

tools.name: proofable_job_create
tools.description: Hands work to one of your agents: now, later, or on a schedule. The run uses only the browser, web search and connected apps its permission allows, and spends credits for tokens and compute. Returns jobId for proofable_job_get, recurrenceId for a schedule, and proofUrl for its receipt. Set requiresJobApproval to hold the run for proofable_job_decide. You must own the agent or hold its permission; check with proofable_agent_link. Write the prompt as the outcome wanted.

tools.name: proofable_job_get
tools.description: Reads one run by jobId: status (pending, running, waiting_approval, completed, failed or cancelled), result, and any approval it is waiting on. Read-only and free. Use it to follow a run from proofable_job_create; approve or deny a waiting run with proofable_job_decide.

tools.name: proofable_job_list
tools.description: Lists runs for the agents you manage. Filter by status (pending, running, waiting_approval, completed, failed, cancelled), or pass scheduled for recurring series; pass since to skip old runs. Runs are newest first. Read-only and free. For one run's full result, use proofable_job_get; to act on a waiting run, use proofable_job_decide.

tools.name: proofable_job_decide
tools.description: Approves or denies a run held at waiting_approval. The job owner, a wallet on the owner profile, a wallet holding permission over the job agent, or an admin can decide; the job agent itself cannot. Approve puts it back in the queue; deny fails it, nothing executes, and it cannot be undone. Find waiting runs with proofable_job_list (status waiting_approval) or proofable_job_get.

tools.name: proofable_job_cancel
tools.description: Stops a pending or running job by jobId, or ends a recurring series by the recurrenceId proofable_job_create returned, so no further runs start. A finished job returns already_done. Actions already taken stay in effect and spent credits are not refunded. Cannot be undone; to run the work again, use proofable_job_create.

examples.title: Check before an agent acts
examples.description: Confirm who controls the agent and what it may do before a sensitive action.
examples.prompt: Before you run tools that change data or spend money, use Proofable to check this agent's permissions. Start with proofable_context.

examples.title: Connect an agent
examples.description: Give an agent an owner and permissions on your Proofable profile.
examples.prompt: Link this agent to my Proofable profile. Use proofable_agent_link first and proofable_agent_create only if setup is missing.

examples.title: Reuse a proof
examples.description: Check for an existing proof before verifying again.
examples.prompt: Check whether I already have the required proof before verifying again.
